minutes.headline: Committee heard a bullying-law briefing, approved paraprofessional mentor stipends, and met the new Turkey Hill principal.
minutes.summary: The meeting honored three retirees, announced a new Turkey Hill Elementary principal, and approved posting paraprofessional mentor positions. Most time went to a long discussion of the state anti-bullying law with principals. The committee also received a Keystone Collaborative property update and school improvement plan progress reports, then went to executive session.

public_comment.topic: Asked the committee to define equity, criticized the superintendent's equity graphic, and asked about an equity team, tiered learning, and student data profiles.

votes.motion: Go into executive session for negotiation strategy with non-union personnel and adjourn following

budget_items.what_was_said: Building-based mentors would receive a stipend for the year and the lead mentor a larger one.
A member estimated total spending and asked whether an existing line covers it; the answer was it comes from the line of the position the person is chosen from.
A class presented a check to the police officer for stuffed dogs for children.

budget_items.what_was_said: No financial impact on Lunenburg since Keystone has its own budget.

Superintendent said the bullying plan will be streamlined over the summer.
Next meeting agenda set: assessment data, next year's meeting calendar, family-school partnership presentation.
Instructional equity discussion to be placed on the list, probably for the fall.

what_happened.line: The committee voted to approve posting paraprofessional mentor positions, with building-based mentors and a lead mentor receiving stipends.
Most of the meeting went to a briefing and discussion with principals on the state anti-bullying law.
The superintendent said the bullying plan will be streamlined over the summer.
The superintendent announced a new Turkey Hill Elementary principal starting July 1.
The committee was told the Keystone Collaborative property purchase has no financial impact on Lunenburg, since Keystone has its own budget.

why_it_matters: The mentor stipends are paid from the budget line of the position each mentor is chosen from, so no separate line shows their cost in the school budget.
A streamlined bullying plan is a policy document the committee is likely to be asked to adopt, and it governs how schools respond to reports.
watch_next: A late-June meeting for the business office to close out purchase orders, with open ones coming to the committee for approval to carry over.
The next agenda: assessment data, next year's meeting calendar and a family-school partnership presentation.
